name: sve-auto-check-fullstack
description: Fullstack NestJS (Backend) + ReactJS (Frontend) Auto Check System for SV Express

scripts.start: npx concurrently -k -n "BACKEND,FRONTEND" -c "blue,magenta" "npm run be" "npm run fe"
scripts.i:all: npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix frontend
scripts.build:all: npm run build --prefix backend && npm run build --prefix frontend

author: Antigravity
